summary.text: April Rose is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 5 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The district elects three delegates, and the general election field also includes Republicans Chris Tomlinson and Steve Whisler and Democrats Dayana Bergman, Alison Rudolph and Courtney Welch.

paragraphs.text: April Rose was born in Salisbury, Maryland, and attended Arlington Baptist High School in Baltimore and Villa Julie College.

According to her legislative biography, she worked as an underwriter at Countrywide Home Loans, a licensed realtor, an events coordinator and fundraiser for the Maryland Republican Party, and communications coordinator for the Maryland Republican Caucus.
She was vice president of special projects at the Maryland Taxpayers Association and has been a recruiter and human resources manager at NMR Consulting since 2009.
Ballotpedia says Rose assumed office on March 16, 2015.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Economic Matters Committee.
